sents.t: On Easter Sunday, Danny invited me to his family’s house for lunch.
But first, we went to the Easter egg hunt in Oakville Park.
I had never seen one before.
Danny’s daughter, Mia, is eight, and his son, Leo, is five.
They were wearing bunny ears and carrying little baskets.
Early that morning, volunteers hid hundreds of colorful plastic eggs all over the park.
There was candy or a small toy inside every egg.
“Ready, set, go!” a man shouted, and fifty children ran across the grass.
Leo found three eggs under a bush right away.
Suddenly, a man in a big white rabbit costume appeared.
The older children ran to take photos with him.
After the hunt, we went to Danny’s house.
His wife, Sarah, cooked ham, and we ate deviled eggs and carrot cake.
Rosa’s wrist was almost better, so she could finally cut the cake herself.
In the afternoon, we dyed real eggs with the kids.
My hands were blue and pink for two days!

comp.q: Where was the Easter egg hunt?

comp.fa: چه کسی با لباس مبدل ظاهر شد؟

comp.q: Why were Sam’s hands blue and pink?
o: He dyed eggs with the kids.
comp.fa: چرا دست‌های سام آبی و صورتی بود؟
